raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 12 was re-delivered at 05:00 on top of its 02:00 load, so 317 POSTED transactions appear twice in raw_transactions (same txn_id, different ingest_ts). The txn_id range is contiguous, so the extra rows are duplicates, not missing data, and the 2026-01-16 volume spike comes from the same batch. Keeping one row per txn_id, the latest ingest, in silver_transactions should correct silver and all downstream gold tables.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts, txn_date FROM (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) AS rn FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') d WHERE rn = 1;"}}
